<\STATESEP>chapter "A simplified version of the actual capDL specification."<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory Types_D
imports "HOL-Library.Word"
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_object_id = "32 word"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_object_set = "cdl_object_id set"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_size_bits = nat<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_cnode_index = nat<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_cap_ref = "cdl_object_id \<times> cdl_cnode_index"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype cdl_right = AllowRead | AllowWrite | AllowGrant<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype cdl_cap =
    NullCap
  | EndpointCap cdl_object_id "cdl_right set"
  | CNodeCap cdl_object_id
  | TcbCap cdl_object_id<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_cap_map = "cdl_cnode_index \<Rightarrow> cdl_cap option"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>translations
  (type) "cdl_cap_map" <= (type) "nat \<Rightarrow> cdl_cap option"
  (type) "cdl_cap_ref" <= (type) "cdl_object_id \<times> nat"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_cptr = "32 word"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record cdl_tcb =
  cdl_tcb_caps :: cdl_cap_map
  cdl_tcb_fault_endpoint :: cdl_cptr<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record cdl_cnode =
  cdl_cnode_caps :: cdl_cap_map
  cdl_cnode_size_bits :: cdl_size_bits<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype cdl_object =
    Endpoint
  | Tcb cdl_tcb
  | CNode cdl_cnode<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_heap = "cdl_object_id \<Rightarrow> cdl_object option"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_component  = "nat option"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_components = "cdl_component set"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym cdl_ghost_state = "cdl_object_id \<Rightarrow> cdl_components"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>translations
  (type) "cdl_heap" <= (type) "cdl_object_id \<Rightarrow> cdl_object option"
  (type) "cdl_ghost_state" <= (type) "cdl_object_id \<Rightarrow> nat option set"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record cdl_state =
  cdl_objects :: "cdl_heap"
  cdl_current_thread :: "cdl_object_id option"
  cdl_ghost_state :: "cdl_ghost_state"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype cdl_object_type =
    EndpointType
  | TcbType
  | CNodeType<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  object_type :: "cdl_object \<Rightarrow> cdl_object_type"
where
  "object_type x \<equiv>
    case x of
        Endpoint \<Rightarrow> EndpointType
      | Tcb _ \<Rightarrow> TcbType
      | CNode _ \<Rightarrow> CNodeType"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition cap_objects :: "cdl_cap \<Rightarrow> cdl_object_id set"
where
    "cap_objects cap \<equiv>
       case cap of
           TcbCap x \<Rightarrow> {x}
         | CNodeCap x \<Rightarrow> {x}
         | EndpointCap x _ \<Rightarrow> {x}"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition cap_has_object :: "cdl_cap \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
    "cap_has_object cap \<equiv>
       case cap of
           NullCap          \<Rightarrow> False
         | _                \<Rightarrow> True"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition cap_object :: "cdl_cap \<Rightarrow> cdl_object_id"
where
    "cap_object cap \<equiv>
       if cap_has_object cap
         then THE obj_id. cap_objects cap = {obj_id}
         else undefined "<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>lemma cap_object_simps:
  "cap_object (TcbCap x) = x"
  "cap_object (CNodeCap x) = x"
  "cap_object (EndpointCap x j) = x"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>proof (prove)
goal (1 subgoal):
 1. cap_object (TcbCap x) = x &&& cap_object (CNodeCap x) = x &&& cap_object (EndpointCap x j) = x<\STATESEP>by (simp_all add:cap_object_def cap_objects_def cap_has_object_def)<\STATESEP>1<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  cap_rights :: "cdl_cap \<Rightarrow> cdl_right set"
where
  "cap_rights c \<equiv> case c of
      EndpointCap _ x \<Rightarrow> x
    | _ \<Rightarrow> UNIV"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  update_cap_rights :: "cdl_right set \<Rightarrow> cdl_cap \<Rightarrow> cdl_cap"
where
  "update_cap_rights r c \<equiv> case c of
      EndpointCap f1 _ \<Rightarrow> EndpointCap f1 r
    | _ \<Rightarrow> c"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  object_slots :: "cdl_object \<Rightarrow> cdl_cap_map"
where
  "object_slots obj \<equiv> case obj of
    CNode x \<Rightarrow> cdl_cnode_caps x
  | Tcb x \<Rightarrow> cdl_tcb_caps x
  | _ \<Rightarrow> Map.empty"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  update_slots :: "cdl_cap_map \<Rightarrow> cdl_object \<Rightarrow> cdl_object"
where
  "update_slots new_val obj \<equiv> case obj of
    CNode x \<Rightarrow> CNode (x\<lparr>cdl_cnode_caps := new_val\<rparr>)
  | Tcb x \<Rightarrow> Tcb (x\<lparr>cdl_tcb_caps := new_val\<rparr>)
  | _ \<Rightarrow> obj"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  add_to_slots :: "cdl_cap_map \<Rightarrow> cdl_object \<Rightarrow> cdl_object"
where
  "add_to_slots new_val obj \<equiv> update_slots (new_val ++ (object_slots obj)) obj"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  slots_of :: "cdl_heap \<Rightarrow> cdl_object_id \<Rightarrow> cdl_cap_map"
where
  "slots_of h \<equiv> \<lambda>obj_id.
  case h obj_id of
    None \<Rightarrow> Map.empty
  | Some obj \<Rightarrow> object_slots obj"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  has_slots :: "cdl_object \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "has_slots obj \<equiv> case obj of
    CNode _ \<Rightarrow> True
  | Tcb _ \<Rightarrow> True
  | _ \<Rightarrow> False"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  object_at :: "(cdl_object \<Rightarrow> bool) \<Rightarrow> cdl_object_id \<Rightarrow> cdl_heap \<Rightarrow> bool"
where
  "object_at P p s \<equiv> \<exists>object. s p = Some object \<and> P object"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>abbreviation
  "ko_at k \<equiv> object_at ((=) k)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
